description.zh:
以图搜图应用实例的描述信息。

支持中文汉字、英文大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过1024个字符，一个汉字算2个字符。
description.en:
The description of the image search application instance.

The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The description can be up to 1,024 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh:
以图搜图应用实例的名称。 

支持中文汉字、英文大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符，一个汉字算2个字符。
description.en:
The name of the image search application instance. 

The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account that can invoke this operation is 100.
    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
